verdict.rationale: The Jobs API's standard ingestion method accepts a URL to a publicly accessible audio file, which the service fetches itself. A custom user-agent option for the fetch and redaction of the input_url corroborate server-side fetching, so no upload is needed for public URLs. Signed or pre-authenticated URLs (e.g., S3/GCS presigned links with query-string credentials) are never explicitly documented, so only the public-URL half of the story is confirmed. missing for 10: explicit documentation of signed/presigned URL support, independent or hands-on corroboration of URL fetching.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass a public or signed URL and the service fetches and transcribes the recording without my uploading it

citations.quote: Submit a URL to a publicly accessible audio file. This is the standard method and is suitable for most use cases.
Custom user agent header to fetch the audio file.
